name: Quotineer
author: isomite

sections.description:
Quotineer turns “How much does this cost?” into a captured lead — instantly.

A focused, no-bloat quote form plugin for WordPress. No subscriptions for the basics, no page builders required.

Core Features

  • Real-Time Calculator — Prices update instantly as the customer selects options. No page reloads.
  • 4 Field Types — Dropdowns, Radio buttons, Quantity inputs, and Toggle switches.
  • Live Total Display — An animated “Estimated Total” that pulses as the customer builds their quote.
  • Lead Capture — Name, email, and phone fields built-in.
  • Email Notifications — Admin and customer confirmation emails sent automatically.
  • Submissions Dashboard — Every lead logged in your WordPress admin with status tracking (New → Contacted → Won/Lost).
  • Shortcode Embed — Add [quotineer_request id="1"] to any page, post, or widget.
  • Simple Form Builder — Visual drag-and-drop editor. No coding required.

Why Quotineer?

Most quote form plugins are either too complex, require WooCommerce, or cost a fortune for basic features. Quotineer gives you a fast, focused tool to capture quote leads — nothing more, nothing less.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the quotineer folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress › Plugins
  3. Go to Quotineer in your admin menu
  4. Edit or create a form, then copy the shortcode
  5. Paste [quotineer_request id="1"] into any page or post
sections.faq:
Does this work with any theme?

Yes. Quotineer outputs clean HTML and minimal CSS that works with any theme.

How do I embed the form?

Use the shortcode [quotineer_request id="X"] where X is the form ID shown in the Forms list. Works in the block editor, classic editor, and most page builders.

Can I have multiple forms?

Yes. Create unlimited forms, each with their own fields and pricing.

Where are submissions saved?

All submissions are stored in your WordPress database and viewable under Quotineer → Submissions. You will also receive email notifications.
